sections.label: Hero
sections.writeInstructions: Lead with local intent and primary keywords. Problem → promise → CTA. Do not invent licenses, years, or review counts.

sections.label: Trust / proof strip
sections.writeInstructions: Short proof points only from site-config socialProof. Skip fabricated awards.

sections.label: Intro
sections.writeInstructions: 180–220 words defining the offer, who it’s for, and local relevance. Seed primary keywords naturally.

sections.label: Services grid
sections.writeInstructions: Section intro + H3 per residential/commercial service from site-config. Each H3: what it is, when needed, outcome. Optional photo per service.

sections.label: Process / how we work
sections.writeInstructions: Numbered steps: consult → plan → install → follow-up. Include realistic timing cues. Optional step images.

sections.label: Deep offer process (single-offer)
sections.defaultHeading: How {niche} works from start to finish
sections.writeInstructions: Deeper specialty process for single-offer niches. Methods, prep, install, cleanup. No multi-service grid.

sections.label: Why choose us
sections.writeInstructions: 3–5 concrete reasons: craftsmanship, materials, local knowledge, communication. No fake awards.

sections.label: Service areas
sections.writeInstructions: List target suburbs from site-config. Short local intent lines; link to location pages if enabled.

sections.label: Cost & pricing guidance
sections.writeInstructions: Honest ranges and cost drivers only. Never invent fixed quotes. Point to free estimate CTA.

sections.label: Materials & methods
sections.writeInstructions: Explain materials/options and why they matter for durability and local climate. Educational value for SEO.

sections.label: Timeline
sections.writeInstructions: Realistic project timelines and stage expectations. No fabricated guarantees.

sections.label: Before & after
sections.writeInstructions: Caption each pair with problem → solution. Photos required for this section to shine; write strong alt text.

sections.label: FAQs
sections.writeInstructions: 6–10 Q&As: when to call, cost drivers, timeline, DIY vs pro, maintenance. Match People Also Ask style.

sections.label: Reviews
sections.writeInstructions: Only use reviews from site-config socialProof. Skip section if none.

sections.label: Codes & permits
sections.writeInstructions: General educational guidance; tell readers to verify local rules. Do not invent jurisdiction-specific legal claims.

sections.label: DIY vs hire a pro
sections.writeInstructions: Honest comparison: when DIY is fine, when a pro saves money/risk. High SEO value.

sections.label: When to call
sections.writeInstructions: Warning signs and scenarios that mean it’s time to book. Helpful, not alarmist.

sections.label: Closing CTA
sections.writeInstructions: Short close with phone/form CTA. Reinforce local service area.

sections.label: Service hero (H1)
sections.writeInstructions: H1 + supporting line for this specific service. Local intent; no invented credentials. Frontmatter: title, description, h1, serviceName, heroImage optional.

sections.label: Service intro
sections.writeInstructions: 150–200 words defining this service, who it’s for, and local relevance. Use {serviceName} naturally with city keywords.

sections.label: What’s included / scope
sections.writeInstructions: Clear scope: what’s typically included, what’s optional, what the customer should prepare. Honest boundaries beat vague promises.

sections.label: Service process
sections.writeInstructions: Numbered steps for this service: consult → plan → work → follow-up. Include realistic timing cues.

sections.label: Cost & pricing
sections.writeInstructions: Cost drivers and ranges for this service only. Never invent fixed quotes. Point to free estimate CTA.

sections.label: Materials & methods
sections.writeInstructions: Materials/options relevant to this service and local climate. Educational SEO value.

sections.label: Timeline
sections.writeInstructions: Realistic timelines for this service. No fabricated guarantees.

sections.label: Before & after
sections.writeInstructions: Caption problem → solution pairs for this service. Strong alt text; paths may be placeholders.

sections.label: Service FAQs
sections.writeInstructions: 5–8 Q&As specific to this service: when needed, cost drivers, timeline, DIY vs pro.

sections.label: DIY vs hire a pro
sections.defaultHeading: DIY vs hiring a pro for {serviceName}
sections.writeInstructions: Honest comparison for this service: when DIY is fine, when a pro saves money/risk.

sections.label: When to call
sections.writeInstructions: Warning signs and scenarios that mean it’s time to book this service.

sections.label: Codes & permits
sections.writeInstructions: General educational guidance for this service; tell readers to verify local rules.

sections.label: Service closing CTA
sections.writeInstructions: Short close with phone/form CTA for this service. Reinforce local service area.

sections.label: About — our story
sections.writeInstructions: Company story without invented history. Focus on approach and local commitment.

sections.label: Contact — how to reach us
sections.writeInstructions: Phone, email, service area, form CTA. Clear next step.

sections.label: Location intro
sections.writeInstructions: Local landing intro for this suburb. Tie niche to community without inventing local facts.

sections.label: Local notes
sections.writeInstructions: Short local relevance: housing stock, common jobs, nearby areas served. No fabricated demographics.

sections.label: Location CTA
sections.writeInstructions: Short CTA with phone/form; link back to Contact / Home.
